findings: Recovery SQL lacks Job.updatedAt and connected-account/charges fields.
recovery_values and read_recovered_bindings retain/accept exactly projectNumber,targetId.
Version2 payment scope requires current amountTotalCents,currency,approvedAt,policyDigest,jobUpdatedAt,connectedAccountSha256 before qualification.
ConnectedEntryTests supplies these fields synthetically; transfer test verifies consumption, not production from actual recovery output.
conclusion: Existing local payment execution proof stands, but full live packet cannot be assembled using the current recovery output alone.
decision: Propose explicit expansion of version2 recovery read/retention contract before implementation; preserve version1.
